sloka: निर्बिभेद ततो बाणैर्हयानस्य महाजवान् ।रामस्तीक्ष्णैर्महावेगैर्वज्रकल्पैः शितैः शरैः ।। ६.१०४.२९ ।।
transliteration: nirbibheda tato bāṇairhayānasya mahājavān ।rāmastīkṣṇairmahāvegairvajrakalpaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.104.29 ।।

translations.english: Rama then released arrows endowed with great speed, shower of multitude of arrows straight into the horses of Ravana and shattered them.
